Game Overview

In Escape the Bomb, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Escape the Bomb, where agile reflexes are your best ally. Navigate through a relentless storm of bombs with simple controls. Stay focused as the pace accelerates, challenging your endurance. Every second survived enhances your score. Can you keep calm and evade the explosive chaos?
